import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartRange
/-! Is the seam's `GeometricallyReduced C.hom` binder FREE in the producer's
context, or a genuine extra hypothesis a joining lane must carry? -/
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
universe u
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
-- no GeometricallyReduced binder supplied:
example : GeometricallyReduced C.hom := inferInstance
end AlgebraicGeometry
